headline: Caregiver

education.credential: Senior High School, TVL Track – Home Economics strand

summary: TESDA-certified caregiver with a year of experience caring for elderly clients in a private home-care service. I help with daily activities, give medicines on schedule, watch for changes in health and keep clients active and cheerful. I am trained in Basic Life Support and first aid.

projects.name: Morning exercise routine for seniors
projects.description: Built a gentle 20-minute morning routine with stretching and walking for two clients; both now walk to the garden every day.

skills: Basic Life Support and first aid
Care of older adults with chronic illness
Daily care notes for families and nurses

experience.title: Caregiver
bullets: Care for two elderly clients at home, one with diabetes and one recovering from a stroke.
Give medicines on time according to the doctor's orders and record each dose.
Check blood pressure and blood sugar and report changes to the family and visiting nurse.
Help with bathing, meals and mobility exercises while keeping clients safe from falls.

experience.title: On-the-Job Trainee
bullets: Assisted caregivers with feeding, bathing and turning bedridden residents.
